# Recommended by SimpleK3s

A curated starting set of dashboards for a quick read on cluster health.
This dashboard is tagged **Recommended-by-SimpleK3s** — filter the dashboard browser by that tag to find this set again.

---

#### Nodes & system resources
- **[Node Exporter / Nodes](/grafana/d/7d57716318ee0dddbac5a7f451fb7753)** — per-node CPU, memory, disk & network utilization
- **[Node Exporter / USE Method / Cluster](/grafana/d/3e97d1d02672cdd0861f4c97c64f89b2)** — utilization / saturation / errors across all nodes
- **[Node Exporter / USE Method / Node](/grafana/d/fac67cfbe174d3ef53eb473d73d9212f)** — USE breakdown for a single node

#### Kubernetes workloads & resource allocation
- **[Compute Resources / Cluster](/grafana/d/efa86fd1d0c121a26444b636a3f509a8)** — requests & limits vs capacity, cluster-wide
- **[Compute Resources / Namespace (Workloads)](/grafana/d/a87fb0d919ec0ea5f6543124e16c42a5)** — per-workload CPU & memory by namespace

#### Storage
- **[Persistent Volumes](/grafana/d/919b92a8e8041bd567af9edab12c840c)** — PV / PVC capacity & usage

#### Cluster services
- **[Kubelet](/grafana/d/3138fa155d5915769fbded898ac09fd9)** — kubelet health, pods & containers per node
- **[CoreDNS](/grafana/d/vkQ0UHxik)** — cluster DNS query rate, latency & errors
